before_conditions: A limit order is submitted to the CLOB contract and added to the book via BookLib.addOrderToBook.
Another order already exists at the same price level.
The existing order at that price has a tailOrder that should be updated.
The new order's prevOrderId and nextOrderId fields are set only in memory, not in storage.
required_property: When a new order is added at a price level where an order already exists, the linked list pointers (prevOrderId and nextOrderId) of the affected orders must be correctly updated in storage so that the order book remains valid and the price applied during matching corresponds to the actual order price, protecting users' funds from being drained.
bad_outcome: The linked list becomes invalid because the new order's prevOrderId and nextOrderId remain zero in storage, creating a discrepancy between the price applied and the actual price of an order when the CLOB matches orders, which allows mismatched orders to drain user funds.
